high_level_description: The image depicts two women embracing each other warmly in what appears to be an indoor setting. The woman on the left is wearing a sleeveless, form-fitting brown dress with a textured pattern. She has long dark hair and is smiling gently while looking down at her friend. The woman on the right is dressed in a black lace-trimmed top and a black skirt. She also has long hair and is smiling softly, with her eyes closed as she leans into the embrace. In the background, there is a wall adorned with framed photographs arranged in a grid pattern.
